title: feat(research): prove exact one-pass twiddle memory bounds
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact number of distinguishable states required at canonical physical-address cuts by a deterministic one-pass synthetic-twiddle header reader.

    physical address prefix
      retain branch vector and reachable modular constant
    physical suffix
      recover exact combined exponent

    distinct suffix functions = distinct required cut states

The all-size formula includes the low bits moved into the source's early prefix. At the literal ell=6,K=2 mixed long/short h=4 cut, there are eighteen residual classes, requiring five state bits. Ignoring that prefix predicts only eight classes. A twelve-axis mixed shape has 114439 classes and needs seventeen bits, although its final modular accumulator has six bits.

This classifies one read-once memory boundary. It supplies no transition implementation, compiler, address producer, packet/layer join, physical supplier or kappa gain. Prefix rereads and irrevocable input-dependent early output change the contract. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The encoded-control handoff leaves address production open; neither the supplied-program interpreter nor the source promises a tiny one-pass state.
  **After:** PROOF.md derives the exact binomial/interval count, its degeneracies and a sharp simpler bit formula. Complete suffix-function enumeration agrees on all 600 physical cut cases and 593228 complete-address evaluations.
- Independent literal modular sums pass 1560 interval cases, and 1152 wide exact-integer cases check the simplified count and bit ceiling. Eleven malformed boundaries reject. Eight actual optimized CLI fault groups reject at intended gates, then a valid optimized retry passes.
- At publication head 05b9168674b6330059b2efc3c7dd19399311d75c, registered CPython 3.12, metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, scoped Ruff and whitespace checks pass. The committed Git-free export passes normal and optimized science plus optimized CLI controls. All fourteen source files and fifteen exported files preserve bytes, modes and identities.

    TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/twiddle-cut-state
    python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/twiddle-cut-state --check-source-history

README gives direct/export commands and the exact next fixture. SOURCES.json pins all runtime and inherited mathematical premises in canonical-main ancestry. Scientific replay needs no foreign pending object or network.

Canonical finding and handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19012411

Credit Nick Petalas's canonical PR3522 circuit/proof, Philipp/mightyOil, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Douglas Colkitt and the retained transform-source lineage. PR3550 is contextual prior work under a different supplied-program/reread contract; no pending source from it is used.

Adds one isolated opt-in package. Frozen inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged.
